title: Institutions must remember the human being behind every dispute: CJI Surya Kant at former CJI BR Gavai's book launch
description: Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant on Tuesday said constitutional promises become meaningful only when institutions remember the human being behind every dispute and ensure that the law retains its human face.The CJI made the remark while speaking at the launch of former Chief Justice of India BR Gavai’s book, The Voice of Justice: Justice Gavai Speaks, held at the residence of Vice President of India CP Radhakrishnan, who was the chief guest at the event.
